addedItems.old:
He is timid and slow to decide. On hearing dangerous news, he first thinks of a place to hide, and he recounts the ledger all night and puts forward his proposal only the next day. Yet he does not back down when it comes to what he believes in.

- Affiliation: Free City Vassal, Lee Clan of the First Sub-Workshop
- Rank: Director
- Title: Heir of the Lee Clan of the First Sub-Workshop
- Occupation: Field cultivation and grain stock management for First Sub-Workshop duties in Oryu 2-dong
- Name: Lee Ilseop. Public pen name iz.
- Contributor: [islee23520](https://github.com/islee23520)
- Community of origin: Lee clan of the First Sub-Workshop. Ancestral seat Jeonui.
- Work location: Oryu 2-dong. At the First Sub-Workshop in Oryu 2-dong, Lee Ilseop recounts the grain stock for winter rations three times and sends a seed-payment proposal up to the Free City Council. He entrusts Park Doyun with confirming receipt of the proposal and has Ryu Donghyeon report only power anomalies in the work area, and he does not extend the use of the field and storage space into clan territory.

**Life.** Heir of the Lee clan that carries on the First Sub-Workshop. In 2121, in his workshop duties at Oryu 2-dong, he tilled the field and managed the grain stock. The field and storage space were used for this work and were neither the clan's territory nor its exclusive property. In 2123, before submitting the winter ration plan, he recounted the grain stock three times, and proposed to the Free City Council that part of the sub-workshop's parts payments be accepted in seed.

**Anecdote.** In 2123, Lee Ilseop recounted the grain stock three times before submitting the winter ration plan, and in the same year proposed to the Free City Council that part of the sub-workshop's parts payments be accepted in seed. It was the heir, who handled field cultivation and stored grain management at Oryu 2-dong, submitting the clan's proposal to the Council.

**Clan.** The Lee clan is a vassal of the Free City, and Lee Ilseop is the heir who carries on the First Sub-Workshop.

**Belief.** He believes the world gets better when farming leaves food to spare.

**Relationships.** As heir of the Lee clan, a vassal of the Free City, he carries on the First Sub-Workshop and, in his workshop duties at Oryu 2-dong, submits proposals to the Free City Council on the sub-workshop's parts payments. He entrusts his direct courier Park Doyun with delivering messages and confirming receipt, and his direct guard Ryu Donghyeon with patrolling the power equipment and reporting anomalies. Lee Ilseop personally cross-checks grain quantities and the ration plan. With Gu Chansol he matches the grain loss ledger against parts transport records, and from Jang Useok he receives the audit results of the parts specification copies to be submitted to the Council. Heo Daon's wheel inspection records are used to check the parts to be shipped from the sub-workshop.

**Ambition.** To fill the winter ration plan with grain from the field he cultivates in his First Sub-Workshop duties at Oryu 2-dong, and so build a sub-workshop with food to spare.

**Fear.** That the grain stock, recounted three times, will fall short of the winter ration plan.

**Intervention.** One can count the grain stock together with him to bring the winter ration plan forward, or back or undermine the seed-payment proposal in the Council.

::: details Appendix — Ledger Figures

- Values: Authority −20 | Openness 40 | Force −30 | Materialism 40 | Communal 30 | Principle 50 | Publicity 50 | Qualification 45 | Decentralization 30 | Transformation 40
- Desires: Craving 35 | Monopoly −25 | Risk −20 | Display −30 | Endurance 70 | Orientation Fluid | Union Contractual Cohabitation
:::
